en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard framed in a decorative arch shape, showing a very large baobab tree that has been converted into a meteorological observation tower. A wooden staircase and platform lead up to a small hut or shelter built at the top of the tree. The surroundings are rural with fencing and vegetation. Red printed captions appear at the bottom and along the left edge.
